name: kai-critic
description: Adversarial critic over a proposal that reality has not yet tested — a design, a strategy, or an instruction. /kai-critic runs three lenses (beneficiary, adversary, auditor) in parallel and blind to each other, merges duplicates and failure chains, verifies every checkable claim, then puts each finding to the owner blind so the gap between his ruling and the main thread's prediction is measurable. The critic names problems and never writes solutions.

desk_path.title: Desk path
desk_path.description: Optional. Absolute path to your own critic desk — the accumulated craft the agent reads before every run. Leave empty to use the generic desk bundled with the plugin. A desk that names your projects, your failures and your conventions is worth far more than the generic one; keep it outside this plugin so updates never overwrite it.
